headline: Approved collections agreement with Rhum Bar and interest rate verbiage edits.
summary: The committee approved August minutes and updated interest rate verbiage. It reviewed the Administrative Plan, RLF portfolio updates including CA Burrito, ImageXpert, and delinquent accounts, and approved pursuing a collections agreement with Rhum Bar.
decisions: Approved David's edit to the interest rate update verbiage.
Approved allowing City staff to pursue a collections agreement with Rhum Bar, with a minimum agreement at their principal debt and staff empowered to negotiate interest and fees.

plain_text:
Minutes for GNRLF Meeting 
9/21/26 – noon  
Room 208, Nashua City Hall 
 
 
Attending Committee Members: David Dearborn, Liz Hannum (12:35), Christine Malloy, Stephen Michon, Lyn 
Tripp. Administration: Abimana Ngira, Kathleen Palmer. Absent: Dawn Enwright.  
 
Call to Order: 12:12 pm. 
Approval of Minutes: for August. Motion to Approve was made by Christine, seconded by David, all in favor; 
approved. 
Interest rate update: Verbiage draft was again updated for clarity. David’s edit was accepted by Motion to 
Approve, made by Christine, seconded by Lyn, all in favor; approved. 
Administrative Plan update:  
Calls to action: 
• Part 1, sections A, B, C (draft by Liz/Abimana): team review before next meeting 
• Part 2 (draft by Stephen): David to review capital markets section 
• Part 3: seems good to go 
• Part 4: Abimana will send to team with some suggested edits based on research of other best practices 
RLF portfolio update: 
• CA Burrito: Loan application remains in process. No updates received from BDC/Karim. 
• ImageXpert: $250k has been disbursed. 
• Delinquent Accounts: Two delinquent accounts had paid small amounts. They must provide additional 
information by September 30 for us to consider a new payment plan. 
• Rhum Bar paid a large amount. The team discussed how to allocate it between principal and interest. 
Additional information is required from the borrower before we can proceed. 
Motion was made to allow City staff to pursue a collections agreement with Rhum Bar with a minimum 
agreement at their principal debt, empowering staff to negotiate on interest accrued and fees. Made by 
Christine, seconded by Stephen; all in favor; approved. 
Call to action: Create an internal “cheat sheet” for EDA/CARES parameters – Liz/Lyn will draft  
Call to action: Lyn to write down collections and balloon payment policies. 
EDA compliance issues:  They have provided a deadline of 90 days from September 20 to update the current 
RLF Administrative Plan. 
Other business:  Liz to revisit UW RFP 
Meeting Adjourned at 1:20 pm.
Next meeting: Noon Monday, Oct. 19, in Room 208.
